original_answer:
Created the required deliverables:

- [pseudobulk_counts.tsv](/workspace/final_answer/pseudobulk_counts.tsv) — 1,429 retained genes × 34 retained individual/cell-type samples, integer raw counts.
- [differential_expression.tsv](/workspace/final_answer/differential_expression.tsv) — one row per retained gene with unshrunken log2 fold change, p-value, and BH-adjusted FDR.
- [method.json](/workspace/final_answer/method.json) — method reported as `DESeq2`.

Analysis summary: 4,903 cells were aggregated by `individual` and `cell_type` using the `counts` layer, retaining 34 samples with at least 10 cells. Gene filtering used N=34, median sample total M=556,360, S=27, and the specified CPM threshold, retaining 1,429 genes. Differential expression used DESeq2 with `~ disease + cell_type`, reference level `COVID-19`, and the `normal vs COVID-19` contrast, so positive log2 fold changes indicate higher expression in normal. P-values were Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted across the retained genes.
